name: Chord Poly Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Chord tunes for Chord Poly in house, techno, dub techno, trance, progressive trance, big room, electro house, electro, future bass, hardstyle, Eurodance, deep house, garage, lo-fi, ambient, pop, soul, synthwave, cinematic and disco and funk styles: chord stabs, organs, pads, plucks, leads and basses. Most tunes make a whole chord from one key.
